Results.ReviewText: completely satisfied with this brand.  It is easy to use, fairly easy to clean and always starts right up.  Because my last grill was a Weber and lasted 22 yrs, it was the only brand I considered when replacing it.  Keep it covered, clean it up and you will get many years of reliable service.
Results.Title: My last Weber grill lasted 22 years!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Grill was easy to assemble and holes in parts were accurately placed. Components appeared to be of high quality consistent w/pricing.  Design of cardboard packaging protecting grill components was so intricate it reminded me of origami. 10 year warranty, free shipping and approx $100 discount direct from factory sealed the deal.  I didn’t want to pay for extra burners I never use.  The only thing I missed was an included rotisserie attachment.
Results.Title: High quality and everything worked after assembly

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
